tools.name: Audio Trimmer

tools.name: Volunteer Roster
tools.description: A free web tool for clubs and schools that need volunteers to cover duty shifts. The organiser posts the shifts, shares one link, and everyone else taps it to claim a slot. Nobody signs up, nobody installs anything, no email addresses are collected, and there are no ads, trackers or cookies. It ships with ten real Australian club duty rosters built in — junior and senior cricket, Little Athletics, nippers, swimming club night, netball, junior AFL and junior league — each with the actual duties,
tools.coreTask: https://bitibybit.com/volunteer-roster/

cades.bestFor: School event coordinators, sports club committees, community fete organizers, and charity leads needing simple volunteer shift sign-up sheets without forcing participants to create accounts or download apps.
cades.privacyVerdict: Roster structures and shift slots are communicated to the first-party /api/roster endpoint to establish unique coordinator and volunteer access links. No user passwords, accounts, or mandatory emails are harvested, and runtime telemetry is confined to privacy-focused GoatCounter beacons and Cloudflare RUM.
cades.benchmarkNotes: Configured a 5-shift, 16-spot community fete roster; generated coordinator view and volunteer link with 0ms task freeze. Verified CSV export via #csvBtn delivering an 18-byte valid UTF-8 BOM header line without authentication gates. Network logging recorded 5 payloads including GoatCounter privacy metrics and the /api/roster creation request.

cades.bestFor: Event hosts, workshop facilitators, and content creators looking to host disposable live Q&A sessions with audience voting and zero registration
cades.privacyVerdict: Ephemeral backend persistence observed; session tokens and visitor IDs are stored in browser localStorage with data automatically deleted upon expiration, and network egress strictly confined to first-party API endpoints and Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot checks.
cades.benchmarkNotes: Recorded 2 direct API payloads alongside Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification, 93ms maximum long task freeze with 0.01 CLS, and complete accordion-based FAQ documentation exploration.

cades.bestFor: Friends, teams, and social organizers needing to quickly coordinate dates, locations, restaurant choices, or time slots using real-time voting links without requiring participants to sign up, enter emails, or download an app.
